fields.description: Allow logged-out visitors to generate a short-lived login QR from their email on the login page. Disabled by default; enabling it trades some enumeration resistance for convenience.
fields.label: Allow QR Generation From Login Page

fields.description: Automatically create a QR Login Credential and email its printable code whenever an administrator creates an enabled System User with a company assigned. Skipped for users without a company.
fields.label: Auto-Issue QR On User Creation

fields.description: Spec 6.2 'Allow own QR download'. When off, a user may still sign in with their own QR but cannot re-download the image.
fields.label: Allow Users To Download Own QR

fields.description: Spec 11. When on, a QR Manager may only manage credentials for users inside the companies the Manager can access. Uses the existing User Permission engine.
fields.label: Restrict QR Manager By Company

fields.description: Spec 6.2. Turning this off is itself recorded as a Security Setting Changed event before it takes effect.
fields.label: Audit Logging

fields.description: Spec 15. QR login is refused over plain HTTP so the credential never crosses the network in the clear. Disable only for local development.
fields.label: Require HTTPS

fields.description: On a shared terminal, terminates any existing authenticated session before issuing the new one.
fields.label: Destroy Prior Session On QR Login

fields.description: 0 disables the client-side idle warning.
fields.label: Idle Timeout (Minutes)
Lockout Duration (Minutes)
fields.description: How long a credential remains locked after too many failed attempts.

fields.label: Replay Protection Policy
fields.description: Controls how a QR credential can be reused. single_use: credential works once. window:credential works within a time window. disabled:no replay protection.

fields.label: Replay Window (Seconds)
fields.description: Time window in seconds during which a QR credential can be reused when replay_policy is set to window.

fields.label: IP Rate Limit Per Hour
fields.description: Maximum QR login attempts per IP address per hour.

fields.label: Max Concurrent QR Sessions
fields.description: Maximum number of concurrent QR sessions per user. 0 means unlimited.

fields.label: Enable Device Tracking
fields.description: Track devices used for QR login.

fields.label: Device Verification
fields.description: log_only: log device info only. require_trusted: require trusted device for login.

fields.label: Revoke Sessions On Credential Revoke
fields.description: Automatically revoke all active sessions when a credential is revoked.
